channel.title: Namibia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Namibia, every source cited.

item.title: Woman found dead in Otjiwarongo flat
item.description: Police investigate multiple stab wounds after ex-boyfriend dies in road incident.

item.title: Namibians question prison comfort versus street struggle
item.description: Life outside correctional facilities offers less security and fewer basic services than life inside, prompting serious discussion.

item.title: Namibia loses N$67.8bn to illicit financial flows
item.description: The finance minister expressed deep concern over suspected money laundering and tax evasion impacting public services.

item.title: Bank of Namibia grants farmers loan holidays
item.description: Commercial banks must offer up to 24-month repayment breaks to farmers and businesses hit by disease and drought.

item.title: Bank of Namibia buys 425kg of gold
item.description: The central bank's gold accumulation programme aims to boost financial resilience and diversify reserves.
